Stage latency.population: 22 unique query runs; 14 retrieve/repack invocations; 6 plans; 10 assessments; 5 answer generations

Token usage and cost.population: All 44 provider calls including one ingestion embedding batch
Token usage and cost.method: Actual SDK usage. Corrected interpretation: diagnostics.json initializes cached counters to zero; for embedding calls those absent counters are unavailable, not measured zero. This inventory supersedes those two cached/output placeholder fields without changing raw observations.
Token usage and cost.aggregation: Sum by role, preserving embedding versus response usage

Reliability.population: Six user requests; provider attempts reported separately
Reliability.method: HTTP/SSE outcomes and observed SDK starts/terminals. Successful transport is separate from the 5/6 semantic gate.

Concurrency and throughput.population: From first answer-request start to final HTTP completion, including intervening history reads
Concurrency and throughput.method: Six sequential planned requests; not a load/capacity benchmark.

update.reason: No update operation in this workload.

delete.reason: No deletion operation in this workload.

value.reindex: Only Apple was newly indexed; paper/lecture extraction and embeddings were reused.

Ingestion and index.population: One Apple upload plus an existing four-file evaluation index
Ingestion and index.method: Client POST duration to ready; storage totals include original PDFs, vectors, SQLite metadata and historical/new conversations. Not vector-only size. Original bytes/ranges/revision guard checked for three queried PDFs.
Ingestion and index.aggregation: Single upload: mean/P50/P95 all equal its observed duration; no capacity inference
